title: Grilled Argentinian Steak with Salad
description: A classic grilled steak dish served with a fresh salad, inspired by the flavors of Argentina.

ingredients.name: Salad
ingredients.notes: Mixed greens with your favorite toppings

instructions: 1. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
2. Season the steak with salt and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
3. Grill the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
4. Let the steak rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
5. In a large bowl, combine your favorite salad toppings and a light drizzle of olive oil.
6. Garnish the salad with chopped parsley.
7. Serve the grilled steak on top of the salad.
